response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT c."circuitId", c."country", COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r."circuitId" = c."circuitId" WHERE r."date" BETWEEN '1978-03-04' AND '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c."circuitId", c."country"), country_avg AS (SELECT "country", AVG(race_count) AS avg_count FROM circuit_counts GROUP BY "country") SELECT cc."circuitId", cc."country", cc.race_count, cc.race_count * 1.0 / ca.avg_count AS ratio FROM circuit_counts cc JOIN country_avg ca ON cc."country" IS ca."country" ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
